method.not_deployed_definition: deploy-drift-guard.py emits NOT_DEPLOYED only when the workers.dev /health probe 404s AND the resolved worker name is positively absent from the CF account script list (GET /accounts/{acct}/workers/scripts). If that list is unavailable the guard degrades to NO_HEALTH_ROUTE instead, so the class can never be produced by a missing token.
method.co_occurrence_proof: The run produced both NOT_DEPLOYED (74) and NO_HEALTH_ROUTE (2). NO_HEALTH_ROUTE is only reachable when the script list IS available, therefore the script list was live and NOT_DEPLOYED is a positive exclusion, not a probe artifact.
method.instrument_positive_control: cf_worker_read qnfo-ops -> 200, version 2.37.22-github409-retry. cf_worker_read qnfo-email-orchestrator -> 200, version 0.4.1-escalate-deadend-fix, size 17015 B. Therefore 404 responses from the same tool are meaningful.
method.invalid_method_rejected: A probe via run_code_net returned HTTP 404 error code 1042 for all 60 hostnames, including variants. Error 1042 is the Cloudflare same-zone Worker-to-Worker block, so the isolate cannot probe *.workers.dev at all. Those results were discarded as a methodology artifact, not evidence of absence.
